cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.4.2)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/home/wdconinc/git/root/cmake/modules")
set(_CMAKE_CHECK_ENABLED_LANGUAGES "C;CXX")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER "/usr/share/emscripten/emcc")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID "Clang")
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LOADED 1)
set(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_VERSION "19.1.7")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER "/usr/share/emscripten/em++")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID "Clang")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LOADED 1)
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION "19.1.7")

project(CheckCUDA LANGUAGES CUDA)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/result.cmake" "set(CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER \"${CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER}\")
set(CMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER \"${CMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER}\")
")
